title: 30A Wine Down | Stay On 30a – Luxury Beach Homes In 30a Florida
meta_description: 30A Wine Down — a condominium in Watercolor, Florida. 6 guests · 2 bedrooms · 2 bathrooms. Book direct with Stay on 30a.
description_expanded: Welcome to Wine Down on 30A, a beautifully curated two-bedroom, two-bath WaterColor condo perfectly positioned above Wine World with front-facing views of iconic 30A.Designed for relaxed coastal living with an elevated touch, this bright and airy condo offers an open layout that feels both inviting and refined. Natural light fills the space, highlighting soft coastal finishes and comfortable furnishings that make it easy to settle in and unwind. Whether you’re enjoying a slow morning coffee, gathering for a casual meal, or relaxing after a beach day, every detail is designed for comfort and ease.Step out to take in the energy of 30A from your front-facing vantage point, or retreat indoors where the atmosphere stays and restful. Both bedrooms provide serene, well-appointed spaces, each paired with its own full bathroom ideal for couples, friends, or a small family traveling together.Guests enjoy access to WaterColor’s premier amenities, including the Beach Club with resort-style pools and private beach access just minutes away. Two adult bikes are included, making it effortless to explore scenic trails, nearby beach towns, and all the dining and shopping along 30A.Perfectly located and thoughtfully designed, Wine Down on 30A offers a seamless blend of convenience, comfort, and coastal charm. Park the car, grab a bike, and start enjoying the best of 30A right outside your door.*Home is on the second floor.HOME HIGHLIGHTSWaterColor Beach Club & Community Pool Passes Included in Rental (Maximum Allotted Wristband Qty is 6)2 Adult BikesFully Equipped KitchenSmart TVsFull Sized Washer & DryerPrivate Outdoor Balcony with Seating overlooking 30ABeach EssentialsShort Walk to Watercolor Beach ClubShort Walk to Camp WaterColorPickle Ball & Tennis CourtsClose to Grayton state Park & Access to the Coastal Dune Lakes (Great for Kayaking & Yolo Boarding) Access to Beachside, Poolside and Lakeside DiningEasy Access to Parks & Walking PathsNearby State Parks & PreservesParking for 2 Vehicles *Parking lot back of buildingElevator on siteACCOMMODATIONS30A Wine Down Sleeps: 6Bedroom #1: King with EnsuiteBedroom #2: (2) Double with EnsuitePRIVATE BEACH & RESORT ACCESSThe WaterColor Beach Club is the only beachfront clubhouse pool available to rental guests along 30A. It is the ultimate amenity with three pools, expanded seating on upper and lower decks, and lounge areas. The Beach Club has several food and beverage options onsite, towel service, and a charming mercantile with sundries for your pool day. With unobstructed and panoramic views of the turquoise waters of the Gulf of Mexico, relaxation and pleasure await you at the Beach Club. Visit the WaterColor Beach Club page for facility hours, lounge chair etiquette, restaurant information, and rules. Wristbands must be worn by guests ages 5 and older. You can access the beach by walking through the Beach Club, and for those who want to sit on the sand, you can set up chairs and umbrellas behind the reserved chair area, or rent your own chairs and umbrellas from the rental shack.NEARBY PUBLIC BEACH ACCESSRay's Multi Mountain Beach Access: Is in the heart of Grayton Beach in "New Grayton", just to the west of the main Grayton Beach drive-on access at Hotz Avenue and the main "Grayton Dunes" access behind The Red Bar.Grayton Dunes Beach Access: Access is ADA accessible, has freshwater showers, and parking on the street. Located at the end of Garfield Street behind the Red Bar in the heart of Grayton Beach. The boardwalk also extends to the end of Banfill Street one block to the east. The access is next to Western Lake outfall and Grayton Beach State Park. The freshwater lake opens periodically and exchanges water with the gulf. Several fishing charters launch off the beach for half-day and full-day trips.WHAT WE OFFERA STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM AMENITIESBody WashShampooConditionerHand SoapToilet PaperDish SoapDishwasher PodsLaundry DetergentPaper TowelsTrash BagsDish SpongeBath TowelsBed LinensPool TowelsWELCOME BUNDLECoffee Grounds2 Keurig PodsPopcornOlive OilFiji WaterPARKINGTwo parking spaces available (2 parking spaces in back of building). No street parking, driveway or gravel spaces only.Included are 2 bicycles (adult) for your convenience.GUEST ACCESSThe WaterColor community is the most desirable community on 30A due to its exceptional community amenities. Guests will have inclusive access to the gulf-front WaterColor Beach Club and new Camp WaterColor facilities, in addition to other beautiful swimming pools located throughout the community.The WaterColor Beach Club features a huge main pool and lounge area, an adults only pool, additional pool deck with even more lounge seating, and third pool area with zero-entry (perfect for even the littlest kids!). It also has dining service available, and a sunset bar, Costa Chica. All of these amenities have beautiful views of the Gulf!Camp WaterColor is geared towards kids and has its main butterfly pool with monarch slide for older kids, caterpillar pool (zero-entry + children's area with skipper slide for younger kids), lazy lizard pool (zero-entry + lazy river), lifeguards on duty, The Canteen restaurant + bar, basketball court, playing field, and playground.OTHER THINGS TO NOTEBeach chairs through WaterColor Beach Club should be reserved in advance.Per Watercolor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 6 wristbands max.In order to receive the proper number of amenity wristbands, you must enter the total number of people in your group upon booking, which you will receive a prompted email prior to your arrival. The HOA will not be able to provide additional wristbands once you are here.The WaterColor HOA will charge $50 per wristband to replace any that are lost. Watercolor requires guest contact information for Watercolor wristband registration a minimum of 1 week prior to arrival.Regarding the WaterColor pools, until water temperatures are consistently warm enough on their own, WaterColor's pools are maintained around 82 degrees.HOUSE RULES*Check-In: After 4PM | Check-Out: Before 10AM*Must be 25 years of age to book. Guests under 25 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian that is staying on premises.*This home is allotted 6 wristbands max per HOA.*No Smoking: Smoking is strictly prohibited including back porch/deck.*No parties or events.*No street parking, parking lot spaces only*During busier times and due to limited infrastructure, internet connectivity may be affected. No refunds will be given for connection issues no wifi, or slow wifi.*This home must remain pet free.IMPORTANT PRIOR TO ARRIVALAll guests will be required to sign a rental agreement, as well as provide a valid ID that matches with the name of the person that made the reservation which includes: 1) a photo of your government issued ID such as a driver’s license and 2) a "selfie".Other things to note
